description: This PHP source file defines the MyReviewAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for listing performance reviews associated with the authenticated user in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to handle GET requests for fetching review data, uses traits for authentication and service logic, and adheres to a collection of RESTful API practices.
